description: Merge audio. Join several recordings into one, in the order you picked. Matching files are joined without re-encoding — instantly and with no quality lost. Accepts audio/*, .m4a, .opus, .aac; up to 200 MB per file.

bitrateKbps.description: Bitrate in kbps. Only used when re-encoding

format.description: Output format. «As is» joins without re-encoding when the files match

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

name: audio_merge
